info.name: Retrieve presigned URL to retrieve the file

items.docs:
Retrieve presigned URL to retrieve the file. Expiration of the URL is
determined by bucket configuration

params.name: q
params.description: Image quality (1-100). Only applies to JPEG, WebP and PNG files

params.name: h
params.description: Maximum height to resize image to while maintaining aspect ratio. Only applies to image files

params.name: w
params.description: Maximum width to resize image to while maintaining aspect ratio. Only applies to image files

params.name: b
params.description: Blur the image using this sigma value. Only applies to image files

params.name: f
params.description: Output format for image files. Use 'auto' for content negotiation based on Accept header
